notes: This is the first genuinely per-poll, individually player-ID-cited real evidence available for the interchange promotion (Issue #204) -- prior evidence was either a single concluded-match snapshot or an aggregate transition-count report with no player identities. It resolves the two residual caveats originally documented in afl_json/match_interchange.py's module docstring and docs/architecture/api/interchange_api_design.md §2.1.

Champion Data player CD_I1028561 (Tom Gross) appeared/disappeared from CD_M20260142409's homeInterchange[] 5 separate times across the full match (poll_sequence pairs (2,48), (100,149), (230,254), (445,482), (556,590) -- appeared/disappeared respectively), confirming genuine individual round-trip bench rotation, not just aggregate set churn. Only the first round trip (polls 2/48/100) is included as fixtures here to keep the fixture set minimal per Issue #204's instruction not to commit an enormous raw capture; the remaining four round trips are documented here for provenance but not checked in as additional fixture files.

23 distinct Champion Data player IDs were observed in CD_M20260142409's homeInterchange[] at some point across the match, all of them appearing and disappearing multiple times (>=3 recorded transitions each) -- consistent with a small, fixed interchange-eligible player pool rotating continuously, not a one-off substitution list.

POSTGAME freeze: this match's diagnostic capture recorded 40 POSTGAME polls (poll_sequence 654-693, spanning exactly the diagnostic profile's configured 600s post-live grace window). Every single field across every one of those 40 polls -- home_interchange, away_interchange (including each entry's interchangeCount/benchReason/timeOnGround/timeOnBench/powerRating), home_counts and away_counts -- is byte-identical to the first POSTGAME poll (654). Zero transition flags of any kind were recorded during POSTGAME. This is the first evidence resolving the previously-open 'POSTGAME/CONCLUDED behaviour' question for POSTGAME specifically: matchInterchange state freezes exactly at the LIVE->POSTGAME transition and does not continue updating, at least through this ~10 minute captured window.

CONCLUDED remains unverified: this match's diagnostic capture ends at poll_sequence=693 (still POSTGAME) -- no CONCLUDED row was ever captured for this match, consistent with the diagnostic profile's post-live grace window (600s) elapsing before matches.status advanced to CONCLUDED. This specific residual question is NOT resolved by this fixture set.
